'''Kessra''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who led the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] unit known as the [[Vipers/Legends|Vipers]].

==Biography==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Kessra and the Vipers fought for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and after the conclusion of the conflict, they were stranded on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]. To avoid arrest by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Kessra and the Vipers went into hiding and reformed themselves into a [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]], and they subsequently seized control of the streets of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Zarra/Legends|Zarra]]. Kessra also secretly began to work for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Darga Jiramma Mionne]] and she used the Vipers as a means by which to achieve Darga's goals in Zarra. In about [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], a group of [[Alderaanian Resistance]] agents traveled to Zarra and landed their [[Baudo-class star yacht|''Baudo''-class star yacht]] [[Banshee (Baudo-class)|''Banshee'']] in the city's [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. Once the agents had disembarked from their [[Starship/Legends|starship]], Kessra and the Vipers surrounded the vessel and claimed that the agents had not paid the Vipers a landing fee, and thus each owed the gang 1,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
